test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Eight persons A to H are sitting at a round table facing its center such that, G is at the immediate left of A and third to the right of D. There are two persons between A and B. C is not the immediate neighbour of B. E and F are adjacent to each other. F is not the immediate neighbour of A and D. C is immediate neighbour of G. Who is second to the left of F?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) G is at the immediate left of A and third to the right of D. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0e9f46db4b498f60924d0ebf1ca54e1f36be373928f82cd3b6ac2baf3a2564c.png] 

2) C is immediate neighbour of G. C is not the immediate neighbour of B.

3) There are two persons between A and B. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7d65567ef3ef2cdce7a8d5f42d5a8abe6b6168c256ed19433576adb6973586b.png] 

4) E and F are adjacent to each other.

5) F is not the immediate neighbour of A and D. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b76a831e36e0bd11cad62beab0ef2a9565d9bc49d2211ab8aa92df4df85ffc3.png] 

Thus, the final arrangement is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93c1cc053f924b9bccc019fbd2cb667f43d034df666add2281c2a9b98a994a48.png] 

Here, we can see that A is second to the left of F.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
